change: Bundle and stage DerelictFreighterFarming mod payload
human_action: Install Surveyor 0.3.50 using Check for update > Install update.
Use an Emergency Signal Scanner, activate pulse drive within 10 seconds, finish the derelict, then repeat in the same system and report whether a new derelict appears.
rollback: Run python tools/github_integration.py rollback-derelict-farming from the Surveyor project folder; it restores backed-up files and leaves post-install modifications untouched.
withdrawal_reason: The Nexus author requires permission before the mod files are reused in another mod. The 0.3.51 package removes the mod assets from the repository's current release files and provides a local archive installer instead. The previous commit remains in Git history.
